description: This file contains the implementation of the user editing feature, including request validation, handling logic, and database interaction within an ASP.NET Core application. It defines a command for editing user data, validates it, and processes the update while managing security aspects such as password hashing.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user data that can be updated, including username, email, password, bio, and image.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Command object encapsulating the user data for the update operation, implementing MediatR's IRequest.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure the User data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the user update logic, interacts with the database context, applies password hashing, and maps the updated person to a User envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the user update operation by retrieving the current user, applying updates, hashing the password if provided, and saving changes to the database, then returning the updated user envelope.
